profile.visual_desc: Bulky bipedal robot with matte-grey plating and navy blue joint accents. Features a rounded, featureless head unit and thick, segmented armor plates on limbs and torso.
profile.face_cutin_desc: Mechanical profile view. Smooth, light-grey helm with a dark horizontal recess. Navy blue internal components visible at the neck. Stoic robotic aesthetic.
profile.weapon_desc: Integrated energy projector within the right forearm.
profile.step1_ready: Rear-isometric view facing ↖. Low crouch on thick mechanical legs with the right arm retracted near the core.
profile.step2_windup: Rotates torso clockwise to coil power. Right fist pulls back further as a small yellow light begins to manifest.
profile.step3_impact: Rapid forward lunge toward ↖. A massive, pale-yellow crescent energy wave sweeps across the screen following the arm's trajectory.
profile.step4_finish: Right arm extended fully toward ↖. The energy arc dissipates into a small spark before the unit pulls back into a recovery stance.
profile.kp7_slash_vfx_rule: The oversized yellow energy arc in Frame 4 correctly originates from the right arm and sweeps toward the top-left target area.

evaluation.diagnosis: Animation adheres to source wind-up and VFX patterns. Mechanical consistency and perspective are maintained.
